## ITSendErrorInfo type

Send-error event delivered to .

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITSendErrorInfo = {
    page: string;
    kind: `fallback-text` | `retryable`;
    chatId?: number;
};
```

## Remarks

`page` is the template page name (`this.data.name`<!-- -->), `kind` is the `Ctx.classifySendError` outcome (`fallback-text` or `retryable`<!-- -->), and `chatId` is the target recipient when known (broadcast recipient id or the current chat id; `undefined` when the update carries no chat). Never carries file contents or full template data.
